caption: The drawing depicts a doll-like figure standing upright, centered against a plain, light background. The figure’s face is a pale peach color and the hair is blonde, styled in two braids on either side of the face. The face features minimal details, with green arched eyebrows, red stitched lines for eyes and mouth, but no discernible nose. On the head is a black bonnet with a brown bow at the top, and a larger brown bow tied at the neck. The upper body is covered by a green shawl draped over the shoulders and secured by the brown bow. The figure’s dress is white with a floral pattern of pink roses and green leaves, and has long sleeves that are slightly puffed at the shoulder. Underneath the floral dress, a white skirt with blue trim and scalloped edges is visible, layered beneath the hem. The waist is cinched with a wide, dark blue or black sash. The figure wears brown shoes, with the left foot slightly forward. The name "Edith Somner" and some writing appear in the lower right corner of the image.
title: Doll: "Maggie Bentley"
